tip.en: Grade hit 24% before your HR had any time to settle — you went from 93 bpm at the gun to 115 bpm in under 45 seconds. Your recent runs average only 38m of total gain; you're burning that budget in one block right here.
tip.zh: 坡度在你心率尚未稳定前就达到24%——不到45秒HR已从93飙至115。近期跑步平均爬升仅38米，而你正在这一段就把配额一次性耗尽。

tip.en: Pace collapsed to 43:52/km at ~18% grade with HR sitting at 148 — you were essentially stationary. This is a smart self-preservation move given the 50m of gain already banked in under 5 minutes, but note the energy cost of stopping and restarting on steep terrain.
tip.zh: 在约18%坡度处配速跌至43:52/公里，心率维持148——基本原地停步。考虑到不足5分钟内已累积50米爬升，这是明智的自我保护，但需注意在陡坡上停停走走的额外体能消耗。

title.en: Plateau Window — Where the Lungs Caught Up

tip.en: You crested onto flat ground at 1140m (the run's highest point) with HR still climbing to 160 at 6:34 pace — a classic cardiac lag after 90m of gain in under 8 minutes. This is the moment to gauge how you've really spent yourself before the descent begins.
tip.zh: 你在海拔1140米的平地上达到本次跑步最高点，心率仍在以6:34配速攀升至160——这是8分钟内爬升90米后典型的心率滞后反应。这是在下降前评估体能消耗程度的关键时机。

tip.en: Max HR of 175 arrived not on the climb but here, mid-descent at -18% grade. Braking muscles are firing hard, your cardiovascular system hadn't recovered from the ascent, and the eccentric load is significant — this is where injury risk on fatigued legs is highest.
tip.zh: 全程最高心率175次并非出现在爬升中，而是在此处——坡度-18%的下坡中途。制动肌群正剧烈收缩，心血管系统尚未从上坡中恢复，离心负荷相当大——这是疲劳腿部受伤风险最高的时刻。

tip.en: GPS pace drops to null and HR falls from 124 to 114 over about 90 seconds — you stopped moving entirely at 1075m after completing the first descent loop. Compared to your recent flat sessions where you never walk, this is a new physiological demand requiring deliberate recovery management.
tip.zh: GPS配速降为空值，心率在约90秒内从124降至114——你在完成第一段下降环路后于海拔1075米处完全停步。与近期从不步行的平地训练相比，这是一种全新的生理需求，需要有意识地管理恢复节奏。

title.en: Second Wind on the Valley Floor

tip.en: HR ticks back up to 132 here as you begin the long valley descent — not from effort but from renewed movement after the rest break. The rhythm from km 2.3 to 2.6 (pace 4:49–5:38, HR 131–134) is your best sustained running of the day, and it's downhill. Worth noting how much the forced rest allowed.
tip.zh: 此处心率回升至132，你开始长段谷地下降——并非因为用力，而是休息后重新启动。公里2.3至2.6段（配速4:49–5:38，心率131–134）是全天最佳持续跑动，且是下坡。值得思考强制休息究竟带来了多大帮助。

title.zh: 第三次爬升，诚实的心率反应

tip.en: HR climbs to 136 on a sustained 8–9% grade at km 3.4 — notably lower than the 148 you hit on the same gradient in the opening kilometer. This shows residual fatigue blunting your cardiac ceiling, not improved fitness. Pace here (~9–10 min/km) is slower than your opening climb pace at equivalent grade.
tip.zh: 在公里3.4处持续8–9%坡度上，心率攀至136——明显低于开场同等坡度时的148。这反映的是残余疲劳压低了心率上限，而非体能提升。此处配速（约9–10分钟/公里）也慢于开场同等坡度时的配速。

title.en: Cardiac Unloading on the Long Wind-Down
title.zh: 漫长收尾中的心脏卸载

tip.en: HR drops sharply from 118 to 112 here as the terrain eases to -6% and you transition into the final 1.3km cooldown descent. For the remaining run HR stays between 89–101 — well below your recent flat-run averages of 134–145. Your body is done spending; it's just carrying you home.
tip.zh: 此处地形缓和至-6%，心率从118骤降至112，你进入最后1.3公里的收尾下降段。之后心率维持在89–101之间——远低于近期平地跑的134–145均值。身体已停止消耗，只是带着你回家。
